_comment: typeCheckingMode is pinned to pyright's default so adding this file changes
nothing about how the existing modules are analysed - it exists only for
tests/ imports build_api_reference from scripts/ via a runtime sys.path.insert
(the same trick that lets the offline suite read ENTITIES without importing
mcp_server). Pyright cannot follow that, so it is told directly rather than
silenced with a per-import type: ignore.
